mapper.sql: SELECT 'SPOT' AS kind, o.id AS trade_id, o.user_id, u.username, o.symbol, o.order_side, o.quantity, o.filled_price, o.filled_amount, o.created_at FROM crypto_order o JOIN "user" u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'FILLED' UNION ALL SELECT 'FUTURES', o.id, o.user_id, u.username, o.symbol, o.order_side, o.quantity, o.filled_price, o.filled_amount, o.created_at FROM futures_order o JOIN "user" u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'FILLED'
